brief.zh: 在单位群上把 n−a 换成 −a，再用 χ²=1。奇特征给 −φ(d)，偶特征给正号。剩余零点和交叉项仍须估计。
brief.en: On the units n−a equals −a. Apply χ²=1 there. Odd parity gives −φ(d), even parity gives the positive sign. Other zeros and cross terms still need estimates.
